metadata.title: Align engine and plugin revisions

applicability.scope: Compatibility of explicit working and target version combinations.
applicability.input_contract: Actual hardware, model, engine, script and flags, benchmark, acceptance criteria, current diagnosis, permitted changes and budget.
applicability.produced_artifact: Version matrix, first incompatible boundary, matched workload checks and rollback point.
applicability.refusal_point: Record missing evidence or an exhausted search budget and identify the smallest discriminating test before declaring success.

limitations: The cards describe routes and acceptance evidence; hardware support and task success require separate validation.

body.json.text:
{
  "task": "version-align",
  "title": "Align engine and plugin revisions",
  "choose_when": "A dependency or engine upgrade must preserve API, ABI, operator or runtime behavior across a stack.",
  "required_inputs": [
    "current and target revisions for each component",
    "compatibility or ABI contracts",
    "known-good configuration",
    "affected integration tests"
  ],
  "steps": [
    "Build a before/after matrix for vLLM, vLLM-Omni, vLLM-Ascend and AFD Plugin as applicable.",
    "Change one boundary at a time; record required pins or adaptations.",
    "Run import, operator, integration and parity checks for the requested combination."
  ],
  "acceptance_evidence": "A pinned compatibility matrix, failing and passing combinations, and a rollback point.",
  "candidate_skill_ids": [
    "repository-evolution-analysis",
    "vllm-ascend",
    "audit-afd-p2p-exchanges",
    "claim-contract"
  ]
}
